category_title: Students with narcolepsy experiencing cognitive slowness and impaired communication
scenario_title: Taking exams and theoretical subjects in large groups
minimal_context: The student is taking a theoretical subject exam while seated in a large group classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please begin working on your history exam now that the whole class is seated.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't... I forgot how to answer these. I knew this before, but the skills are just lost.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Read the questions again and see what you can remember.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't concentrate with everyone in here... I'm having a fatigue attack.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to stay awake and finish the test.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speech is slurred and unclear) Can't... think... (puts head down on the desk, unable to continue functioning)
